circle_binance.terms: Binance agreed to transfer restrictions through the earlier of the second anniversary or termination of specified commercial arrangements

circle_arc_presale.classification: Circle Arc token presale revenue/proceeds; separate from USDC reserve income
circle_arc_presale.accounting_warning: Revenue recognized and cash proceeds are distinct measures; do not add them together or treat either as XRP capital
circle_arc_presale.network_distinction: Arc is a separate Layer 1, not XRPL

coinbase_aggregate_crypto_collateral.table_units: USD thousands in supplemental non-cash investing and financing activities
limitations: no XRP-specific amount is disclosed in this table
period flows are not an end-of-period collateral balance
do not infer XRP collateral acceptance, utilization or demand

circle_coinbase_distribution_reconciliat.interpretation: different accounting measures; Circle distribution costs are not a direct one-for-one reconciliation to Coinbase stablecoin revenue

current_capabilities: local append-only SQLite feature snapshots with stored-at visibility
four deterministic baselines: naive class prior, momentum sign, mean-reversion sign and volatility-normal
chronological walk-forward baseline evaluation with cutoff-available training labels, purge and embargo
overlap-adjusted effective sample size based on non-overlapping target intervals
temporal temperature calibration using earlier outcomes and later temporal validation
fail-closed readiness report validation and independent Ed25519 evaluator attestation

critical_gap.explanation: walk_forward.py evaluates deterministic baselines; forecast_ledger.py validates an independently supplied model-readiness report but does not train a model. barrot_agent/models.py and barrot_agent/inference.py manage IBM Granite 4.0-3B Vision image/text inference, not XRP time-series prediction.
critical_gap.consequence: the current system is an ingestion, point-in-time integrity, baseline evaluation, calibration, drift and forecast-admission foundation; it is not yet a measured learned XRP prediction model

statistical_uncertainty_gap.current_gate: requires model point estimates to beat all four baselines on Brier score and log loss, plus OOS/shadow sample counts, effective horizon windows, calibration, drift, source groups and Ed25519 attestation
not_implemented: paired block-bootstrap confidence intervals for model-minus-baseline Brier differences
paired block-bootstrap confidence intervals for model-minus-baseline log-loss differences
source-clustered uncertainty across independent provenance groups
residual serial-dependence adjustment beyond non-overlapping target-window counting
confidence intervals for calibration error and shadow performance
statistical_uncertainty_gap.explicit_code_limitation: walk_forward._overlap_adjusted_effective_sample_size documents that its non-overlap count does not correct residual serial dependence or shared-source correlation
statistical_uncertainty_gap.forecast_policy: do not issue a forecast until this uncertainty gap is addressed and the model demonstrates robust out-of-sample and shadow superiority

prediction_engine_code_audit.drift_gap: feature_drift.py computes univariate PSI and explicitly does not measure label/concept drift
prediction_engine_code_audit.scenario_gap: scenario_hypotheses.py assembles authored evidence and counter-hypotheses; it does not infer causal relationships or generate forecast probabilities
prediction_engine_code_audit.legacy_accuracy_status: 45.5% is preserved as invalid variable-horizon legacy scoring and is not predictive-performance evidence
next_implementation_sequence: capture synchronized historical spot, L2, derivatives, exchange-flow, ETF, stablecoin/collateral and macro observations through the main-only ingestion workflow
persist exact raw bytes, SHA-256 receipts and trusted external/WORM timestamp anchors with retention sufficient for replay
build and version an XRP-specific candidate time-series model using only point-in-time verified features
evaluate chronologically against all four baselines with purge/embargo
add paired block-bootstrap and source-clustered confidence intervals for Brier/log-loss differences in OOS and independent shadow windows
require robust improvement, calibration, stable feature and concept drift, and independent evaluator attestation before any forecast

source_independence.circle_and_coinbase_10q: separate issuer-primary filings describing the same commercial relationship; accounting metrics are not independent economic flows
source_independence.circle_binance: Circle SEC disclosure is primary evidence for the equity investment; no inference to XRP demand
source_independence.coinbase_collateral: Coinbase SEC filing is primary but aggregate multi-asset and not XRP-specific
source_independence.arc_presale: Circle SEC disclosure is primary; Arc is a separate Layer 1
source_independence.raw_receipts: these filings were web-read and cited but not captured as byte-exact Barrot raw receipts in this run
